proposals.evidence: DEDR621 gives Irula uddya long, Kannada udda/uddi/uddu length or height, Kodagu uddatë long and Tulu udda long. Survey uddā/vuḍḍā/uddu/utta/uddaṭā long preserve that family, including the initial glide and ordinary final-vowel or adjectival variation; longer opaque elicitation responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1097 gives Kannada kaccu bite and Tamil kaccu gnaw/nibble. Survey kacc-/kats-/kac- bite responses are comparative southern variants retaining the source affricate spelling and ordinary final vowels; the semantic fit is explicitly biting. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
